display_name: Gond Clan Chief of a Garh
one_line: A 16th‑century Gond clan chief administering a forested fort-territory (garh) and its chaurasi and barhot villages under the Garha‑Katanga rajas.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, sturdy and athletic forest warrior-administrator build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Central Indian complexion, straight prominent nose, strong jaw, faint horizontal forehead lines, and a calm, assessing gaze; default expression is serious but approachable, as if weighing tribute and alliances.
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a short, high knot at the back of the head with a narrow red cloth band, sides neatly combed; a small, plain silver hoop earring in each ear; no turban or helmet, head left mostly bare.
appearance.costume: knee-length woven cotton tunic in muted forest green with a simple round neck and side slits, belted at the waist by a broad dark-brown leather belt; below, off‑white handwoven cotton dhoti wrapped firmly to mid‑calf with a neat front pleat, and bare lower legs; over the tunic, a sleeveless, medium-thickness quilted cotton coat (padded armor) in dull earthy brown with vertical stitching, cut to just above the knee; a long, plain ochre-brown cotton shoulder cloth draped from left shoulder across the chest and back; simple dark-brown leather sandals; minimal ornamentation: a narrow beaded necklace of dark wooden beads and one small iron pendant, and a single plain iron bangle on the right wrist.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly broad-bladed iron sword of medium length with a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left, and in his left hand a rolled palm-leaf map bundle tied with a red cord, symbolising his oversight of scattered garh, chaurasi and barhot units.

ref_desc: A sturdy mid-30s Gond clan chief with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a short back knot with a red band, forest-green tunic, off-white dhoti, brown quilted coat, ochre shoulder cloth, leather belt and sandals, iron sword at his left and a rolled palm-leaf map bundle in hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a 16th-century Gond clan chief from Central India: a sturdy man in his mid-30s with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, high cheekbones, and a calm, serious gaze, thick black hair tied in a short knot at the back with a narrow red cloth band, and small plain silver hoop earrings. He wears a knee-length forest-green woven cotton tunic with a round neck and side slits, belted by a broad dark-brown leather belt, and an off-white handwoven cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with a neat front pleat, bare lower legs, and dark-brown leather sandals. Over the tunic is a sleeveless quilted cotton coat in dull earthy brown with visible vertical stitching, cut to just above the knee, and a long plain ochre-brown shoulder cloth draped from his left shoulder across chest and back. Add a narrow dark wooden beaded necklace with a small iron pendant and a single plain iron bangle on his right wrist. At his left side hangs a straight medium-length iron sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, and in his left hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf map bundle tied with a red cord, symbolizing his control of dispersed fort and village units; show him from multiple angles with consistent colours of forest green, earthy brown, off-white, ochre, and dark brown.
